text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the parking regulations be amended on Sackville Street and Amelia Street. The proposed amendments will provide short-term parking to accommodate pick-up and drop-off activity for the proposed daycare at 459-461 Sackville Street. These parking amendments will also help deter double sided parking on the sides of the streets abutting this property during pick-up and drop-off hours of operation.
The Item was withdrawn from the agenda.
